Six more songs join the surprises, two get a new look, and one surprise can now hold your own photos.

## New

- **More surprises.** Six more songs the developer loves now come with something extra, and two earlier ones were redone. Play them and see.
- **Your own memories.** In one of the surprises, photos hang and fall near the end of the song. While it plays, open the menu in the player and choose Memories to add up to 20 of your own photos.
- **A photo you can play with.** The hanging photo swings on its string. Pull it or flick it and it swings back.

## Improved

- **Surprises can change more of the player.** The cover can get a frame, the seek bar and the favorite button can take a new shape, and the lettering can change to match the song.

## Fixed

- **Long lyric lines stay on screen.** A line timed as one long piece, like some Japanese lyrics, now wraps instead of running off the edge.
- **Lyrics no longer show a stray "v1:" mark** on lines that have no word timing.

## Good to know

- **Memories only shows up in the menu while that surprise is playing.** Your photos are made smaller and stay on this device. Removing a photo in Memories deletes it.
- **Some surprises flash or shake the screen for a moment.** If Remove animations is on in your Android settings, the screen does not shake and the photos stay still.
- **Double tap anywhere to stop a surprise.** It also ends by itself when the song does.
